headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: Inside Groundbreaking Guidelines for Heart Disease in Women
headlines.description: Four major health groups, including the American Heart Association, came together to create a whole new playbook for preventing and treating heart disease beginning very early in life. Dr. Jennifer Haythe, a cardiologist at New York Presbyterian Columbia University Medical Center, joins TODAY to detail the updated guidelines.

headlines.title: Nearly Half of All US Children Own a Phone by Age 10, Study Finds
headlines.description: Nearly half of all children in the United States have their own phone by age 10, a new Common Sense report finds. Additionally, half of tweens ages 9 to 12 use social media, despite the age requirement being 13. As screen times for children average about five hours a day, what can parents do to limit their device use? NBC's Kate Snow reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Matthew Perry’s Sister Speaks Out for First Time: 'I Still Talk to Him'
headlines.description: Matthew Perry’s sister, Mia Perry Bowick, and Mary Robertson, director of the new docuseries “The One About Matthew Perry,” join TODAY to discuss how they are pulling back the curtain on the late “Friends” star’s life through never-before-seen footage and interviews. headlines.title: Quest Diagnostics reports cyber breach affecting ‘certain patient records’
headlines.description: Quest Diagnostics said it learned of a cyber breach of one of its systems this week, likely compromising some records for patients. The number of patients and records affected is still unknown at this time. NBC News' Kevin Collier has the details of the breach.

headlines.title: Do you really need an exfoliating body wash in your shower routine? Here’s what derms say
headlines.description: Exfoliating body washes help to remove extra dead skin cells that cause acne and dryness — I asked experts whether you actually need one in your routine.

headlines.title: Some hair growth tools work, others are gimmicks — here’s how to tell the difference
headlines.description: Yes, some viral hair growth tools actually work. I spoke to dermatologists and scalp experts about which ones will actually help hair grow and prevent hair loss.

headlines.title: 2nd-generation Apple AirTags are at their lowest price ever: Shop now before it’s gone
headlines.description: Apple’s second-generation AirTag is 21 percent off at the moment, putting it at its lowest price ever. Shop the deal today because it won’t last long.

headlines.title: Ulta’s Early Black Friday sale has Clinique, Medicube and more up to 50% off
headlines.description: Ulta’s early Black Friday sale just landed and it has some of the best deals. Save up to 50% on our favorite brands like Medicube, Clinique, Cosrx and more.

headlines.title: A Physical Therapist’s 30-Second Fitness Snack To Avoid Low Back Pain
headlines.description: Dr. Karena Wu, physical therapist, shares the 30-second “fitness snack” you can do at any time of day to keep your back muscles flexible and pain-free.

headlines.title: ‘Big Brother’ Season 28 Winner Rick Devens Shares Wife’s Breast Cancer Diagnosis
headlines.description: “Big Brother” Season 28 winner Rick Devens and wife Becca Devens have revealed she was recently diagnosed with breast cancer.
